description: Every app Septena imports from, or plans to (ADR 0021, docs/MOVING_IN_SPEC.md §3). The one list: the app's move-in rows and the site's pricing, moving-in and support pages read it, so no copy names importers by hand. `status`: ships (works now, `featureId` names the capability), planned (an importer is on the roadmap), assisted (planned as a guided manual path). `detail` says what moving in does; a ships source needs it. Order is the order people see.

sources.name: Things
sources.detail: Copies your areas, projects and tasks. Things stays as it is.

sources.name: Apple Reminders
sources.detail: Moves reminders into your Inbox. Each one you import leaves Reminders.
